title: Picnics, feast days and parades
summary: Brass bands played picnics at open pavilions, St. Mary's feast day on August 15 and society parades.

Would they have them right on the seashore? Would they be back in the woods or where? Well, they had clubs. Pavilions. They'd have a pavilion? Yes. At that time, it was open pavilions. Most of them would be in the woods. I mean, they went on the picnics. Yeah. There are so many questions I want to ask you. What special days of the year would they have parades over here? You said carnival was big. Yeah, it was big. Big day. Then the societies turned out, you know, different organizations turned out. Some shows. One of the antivacers, you know. St. Mary's Feast Day. What day was that? That was the 15th of August. Every year they'd turn out. The Italian Society would turn out with the brass band.
And then they'd have a big dinner up there. And they'd have dancing out to the dinner. What about 10th of May? Do you have the 10th of May over here?
